name: Dumbbell Standing Overhead Press
summary: A standing press that builds the shoulders and triceps while the trunk and glutes work to keep you stable. It needs only a pair of dumbbells or filled bags.
setup: Stand with feet about hip- to shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Bring the dumbbells to shoulder height with palms facing forward or slightly inward and forearms vertical.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your trunk so your ribs stay down.
execution: Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are almost fully extended above your shoulders.
Move your head slightly forward at the top so the weights finish over the middle of your body.
Lower under control back to shoulder height.
Keep your torso upright for the entire set.
mistakes: Leaning back and arching the lower back: squeeze the glutes, brace the abs and use a lighter weight.
Pressing forward in front of the body: keep the forearms vertical and finish over the shoulders.
Using leg drive by accident: keep the knees still unless you intend a push press.
Shrugging up to the ears at the top: keep the neck long and shoulders pressed down.
